zh.title: 检查字段从哪里来：多智能体验收的证据边界
zh.summary: 隔离函数探针显示，保存检查结论与实际完成核验并非同一步骤。验收接口需要说明字段由谁生成、覆盖什么命题，以及还缺少什么证据。

en.title: After the Causal Label: What an Attribution Module Probe Establishes
en.summary: Nonempty placeholder chains and nonexistent endpoints can activate a causal label in a pinned attribution module. Twelve synthetic calls expose its local acceptance predicate and functioning negative controls, without measuring real-run misattribution rates.
